description: A copy-paste pricing section built from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: a three-tier plan grid with a monthly and annual SvSegmented toggle that applies the annual discount live, a highlighted most-popular SvCard, per-plan feature SvLists with check marks, an SvDivider and a call-to-action SvButton on each plan.

faq.question: How is the annual price computed?
faq.answer: cycle is bound to the SvSegmented; each plan's displayed price is a $derived that applies the discount when cycle is annual, so the cards update instantly.

faq.question: How is the popular plan highlighted?
faq.answer: The plan carries a popular flag that adds an accent border and badge to its SvCard and switches its button to the primary variant.

faq.question: How do I wire the buttons?
faq.answer: Each SvButton's onclick receives the plan; replace the demo toast with your checkout or sign-up navigation.
